analysis:
All 14 implementations round-trip on 1e5 log-uniform values below 2^20; bits per value T_0111 14.20, T_111
14.31, T_101 14.41, Fibonacci 15.57, Elias delta 15.89. The string-based pattern codes need about 3 us per value
against 0.4-0.7 us for the Elias codes and 2.1 us for Fibonacci (CPython; machine-dependent, outside the result
hash).
assumptions: CPython string implementations; absolute speeds are NOT representative of optimised bit-level code, only the relative ordering of these implementations
timings are machine-dependent and excluded from the result hash

question: What do pattern-terminated codes cost computationally relative to classical codes?
